name: Name
name_hint: Letters, digits, _ and -. You pick it by this name in model configuration.
kind_api_hint: The hub calls this API directly, for one-off uses like drafting replies, triage, translation and knowledge processing. It never starts an Agent.
kind_launcher_hint: Runs {agent} on your computers (main chat, Agents). With an address and key, the hub also calls it directly for drafting replies, triage and similar uses when there's no Direct API provider, without starting an Agent.
url_chat_hint: Base URL of a Chat Completions-compatible API.
url_responses_hint: Base URL of a Responses-compatible API.
url_gateway_hint: Base URL of an Anthropic Messages-compatible gateway, without /v1.
auth_bearer_hint: Authorization: Bearer (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN). Most gateways use this.
auth_key_hint: x-api-key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The official Anthropic API uses this.
key_hint: Stored encrypted on the hub and never returned by the API.
test_cost: The model here is only for this test and isn't saved. The default model is set in "Choose models". Testing sends one very short request, which may cost a little.
test_cost_current: The model here is only for this test and isn't saved. The default model is set in "Choose models"; it's {model} now. Testing sends one very short request, which may cost a little.
discover_failed: Couldn't fetch the model list: {error}. You can add models by hand in the next step.
discover_found_one: Found {count} model. Check it in the next step.
discover_found_other: Found {count} models. Check them in the next step.
advanced_badge: Tier models, subagents, headers, proxy, timeout, context
custom_detail: A relay, a company gateway or another Anthropic Messages compatible service. You enter the address and how it signs in.
no_models: No models yet. Use "Fetch models" in the previous step, or add them by hand below.
subagent_hint: For multi-agent runs such as workflows.
force_label: Force subagents to use this model
chat_probe_legacy: Clear the saved settings and save this provider before testing the connection or fetching models.
chat_clear_legacy: This provider has saved settings that Chat Completions cannot use. Clear those settings when saving. Saving is unavailable until you select this.
chat_effort_hint: Chat Completions does not use per-model thinking effort settings.
chat_advanced_hint: Chat Completions does not use provider-specific headers, environment variables, proxy, timeout, context limits, default effort, tier model or subagent settings. You can still record a context window for each model in the list.
headers_set: Set (hidden). Typing new ones replaces them all.
headers_hint: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS. Stored encrypted like the key and not shown again.
env_set: Set (hidden). Typing new ones replaces them all.
env_cleared: Saving clears the saved environment variables.
env_hint: Set last, over the fields above and this computer’s own environment. NAME= with nothing after it sets a variable empty; to go around a proxy for this gateway, add its host to NO_PROXY instead. Stored encrypted like the key and not shown again.
custom_model_hint: Adds one more choice to /model. A description needs a name.
args_hint: Added after claude, separated by spaces, each starting with -.
extension_note: The URL, connection type and models come from the extension "{plugin}". Once added, you can edit it like one you filled in yourself.
key_hint_with: {hint} Stored encrypted on the hub and never returned by the API.
preset_models_error: Couldn't read the extension's model list ({error}). These are the ones it declares.
default_model_hint: Each use's choice is managed in "Model configuration". This default applies when none is set.
pick_intro: Pick one and paste its API key. The address and models are filled in for you.
presets_failed: Couldn't read the hub's providers: {error}. You can still add a custom compatible gateway.
where_key: Where do I get a key?
assign_label: Use it for the main conversation and new Agents
assign_hint: Only where nothing was picked yet. Models you chose stay as they are.
name_auto: Leave empty to name it automatically
key_test_cost: It's tested once after you paste it with a very short request, which may cost a little.
key_test_responses: This provider's protocol cannot be tested here.
done_pick_later: To use it for the main conversation or Agents, pick it under Models.
direct_note: The main conversation and Agents can't run on it. Processing, Sorting and other uses without a picked model may now use it; change that under Models.
assign_hint_works: The main conversation already works with Claude Code on {machine}, so this is off. Turn it on to use this key instead (only where nobody has picked a model).
assign_hint_works_here: The main conversation already works with Claude Code on your computer, so this is off. Turn it on to use this key instead (only where nobody has picked a model).
done_no_claude: The key is saved. Claude Code still needs to be installed on {machine} before the main conversation can use it.
done_no_claude_any: The key is saved. Claude Code still needs to be installed on the computer before the main conversation can use it.
assign_checking: Checking whether the main conversation already works…
done_no_claude_kept: The key is saved. Claude Code still needs to be installed on {machine} before anything can run on it.
done_no_claude_kept_any: The key is saved. Claude Code still needs to be installed on the computer before anything can run on it.
